0d41c0ed9d7bbce4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب تقويم أسنان ووجه وفكين للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تتطلب تدخلات تقويمية وجراحية، مع التركيز على تقديم رعاية شاملة لجميع أفراد الأسرة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة ويعمل بنظام الدوام الكامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تحتاج إلى عمليات وأجهزة تقويم لجميع أفراد الأسرة، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية المناسبة. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة للأسنان والفكين، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية وتحليلها لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة. تجهيز وتطبيق التقويمات للفك والأسنان، بما في ذلك أخذ القياسات ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. معالجة التهابات اللثة وإجراء جراحات تقويم الفكين الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية اللازمة. متابعة تجهيز تركيبات التقويمات السنية وتثبيتها، وضمان فعاليتها وراحة المريض. تطوير الممارسات المهنية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. متابعة جميع أفراد الأسرة وملاحظة أمراض الأسنان والوجه والفكين الوراثية والعمل على الوقاية منها. إعداد التقارير والتوثيق إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تقديم التوصيات لتحسين الصحة العامة للأسنان والتقليل من المخاطر التي قد تهددها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين ضمن فريق عمل في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في حائل، بنظام الدوام الكامل. يساهم الدور في تقديم خدمات طب الأسنان المتخصصة للمجتمع المحلي.

0dce88e8edac1cb3.description: We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our Mechanical Services Shops. Mechanical Services Shops is responsible for providing rotating and static equipment repair and fabrication of components. Your primary role is to develop and optimize routes for precision components produced through machining, additive, welding, casting, heat treatment, and related processes. You will ensure designs are executable and that operations achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity objectives. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: · Process Development: Create routings, process plans, work instructions, control plans, inspection points, and production standards for new and repaired components. · Design for Manufacturability: Review drawings and models, identify risks, recommend tolerances and appropriate method, and coordinate technical queries with reverse engineering and quality teams. · Production Planning & Optimization: Balance capacity, sequence operations, define tooling and fixtures, reduce setup and cycle time, and improve throughput, yield, and equipment utilization. · Failure & Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate machining, fabrication, dimensional, material, and assembly failures using structured problem-solving; implement verified corrective and preventive actions. · Industrialization & Governance : Lead fabrication of parts, process validation, material supplier technical reviews, and transfer of qualified methods into repeatable production. You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or Materials Engineering from a recognized and approved program. You will have at least 15 years of manufacturing-engineering experience, including a minimum of 8 years developing and optimizing industrial production processes for Aerospace or Oil and Gas. Broad knowledge of machining and at least two additional processes such as additive manufacturing, casting, heat treatment, or assembly is required. Proficiency in process planning, tooling and fixture design, CAD/CAM collaboration, capacity analysis, and production-data interpretation is necessary. SME CMfgE, ASQ CQE, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or comparable professional certification is preferred. Having simulations certification and all siemens certification for NX CAD/CAM/CAE (NX Teamcenter quality associated Certificate, NX CAD Design Associate Level Certificates, NX CAM Manufacturing Associate Certificate, NX Simcenter 3D CAE Associate Certification, NX Additive Manufacturing Associate Certification, NX Teamcenter quality associate Certificate, NX Designer Certified Professional (NX) Certification) is strongly preferred.

0db9bedc2ab51077.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قيادة وتشغيل الشاحنات الصغيرة لنقل المواد والمعدات بين المواقع المختلفة، مع الالتزام التام بمعايير السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال القيادة والنقل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة وتشغيل الشاحنات الصغيرة المخصصة للنقل. نقل المواد والمعدات بأمان وكفاءة بين المواقع المحددة. إجراء الفحص اليومي للمركبة للتأكد من جاهزيتها وسلامتها التشغيلية. الالتزام الصارم بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق وتعليمات السلامة الخاصة بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات كسائق شاحنة صغيرة أو ما يعادلها. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع المركبات المطلوبة. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمواعيد العمل والمهام الموكلة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. الاستعداد للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك. بيئة العمل سيعمل السائق ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التنقل بين مواقع العمل المختلفة في تبوك. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والتشغيلية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

0d48440b09223636.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سفاري عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحقيق الأهداف الإدارية للقسم، وتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المتنوعة. يهدف الدور إلى المساهمة في اقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تدعم تحقيق هذه الأهداف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم. أداء وتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المختلفة. اقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق الأهداف. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة في الفرع أو الإدارة. ضمان نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطوير أداء الزملاء وتحسينه. تنفيذ مختلف العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية لتغطية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ المهام الإدارية المتنوعة بكفاءة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل ونقل المعرفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الأخصائي الإداري ضمن فريق يدعم الأهداف التشغيلية والإدارية للشركة. طبيعة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق، مع التركيز على الدقة والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. يشمل الدور مهام تتطلب التخطيط والتنفيذ والمتابعة لضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيناقش خلال عملية التوظيف. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة سفاري والمساهمة في دعم العمليات الإدارية في بيئة عمل ديناميكية.

0d4cb0ec0b98dfac.description: About the Role Honeywell International Inc. is seeking a Senior Territory Manager for a full-time position. This role is responsible for promoting and selling fire alarm and life safety solutions within a designated territory to achieve annual sales plans and drive long-term business growth. The Senior Territory Manager will collaborate across various functions, product lines, and brands to develop a coordinated market approach, engaging with key influencers, stakeholders, and channel partners to capitalize on growth opportunities. Company Overview Honeywell Technologies is a global automation company focused on solving mission-critical challenges and enhancing quality of life. The company serves the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, supported by its Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. With over 50,000 employees and decades of data from a global installed base, Honeywell is positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy. Key Responsibilities Achieve 100% of channel sales targets according to the Annual Operating Plan (AOP). Develop and maintain the customer base in Industrial & Infrastructure, Ministry Buildings, Governmental Complex, and Commercial sectors, aligning with company sales and marketing strategies. Conduct frequent meetings with customers to agree on annual sales plans and hold regular review meetings quarterly. Engage with end customers and consultants for required approvals and specifications. Actively participate in trade shows, seminars, and relevant trade events. Provide timely feedback on time management, call reports, market requirements, customer issues, competitor activity, and new business opportunities. Develop a comprehensive understanding of the marketplace, focusing on consultants, specifiers, developers, strategic partners, and key stakeholders in fire and security projects. Work with marketing and functional leaders to develop strategic plans for the market and key growth segments. Provide timely input into the Strategic Plan (STRAP) and AOP processes annually. Assist Marketing in implementing partner programs and pricing models for initial product supply. Collaborate with legal, finance, and other functions to establish supply and revenue agreements with key partners and developers. Develop new strategic partnerships with major system integrators and distribution providers. Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure a complete product portfolio and a strong New Product Introduction (NPI) process. Work with partners to build consumer-focused communication plans. Ensure cost-effective terms in conjunction with the supply chain team. Align strategy and next steps to position Honeywell through cross-business efforts. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Accountable for achieving and exceeding quarterly channel sales and pricing goals to maintain desirable margin/discount targets. Ability to prepare and agree on AOPs that reflect maximum growth opportunities. Experience in planning, promoting, and launching new products and solutions, ensuring clear messaging and value propositions. Capability to establish a robust Management Operating System (MOS) and Tier meeting process. Skilled in conducting periodic business reviews with customers to manage performance and maximize opportunities. Proficiency in managing and reviewing pricing strategies, discounts, and growth-based incentive schemes. High level of presentation skills to deliver clear messages to diverse audiences. Experience working with long-term strategic vendors or partners. Background in design, marketing, and sales of Fire Alarm & Suppression Systems across all segments and standards. Proficient in NEX usage, with a clear understanding of utilization and maximization, including creating/modifying opportunities and logging tasks/activities/events. Overdue percentage of opportunities (leading, not won, not lost, any open sales stage) with a past close date shall be less than 5%. Ratio Pipeline (Current Quarter): Value of opportunities with closing date in the next three months (leading, open status & probability 70% & 90% only) versus next three months AOP shall be 4x pipeline coverage for M+4 and beyond. Conversion Rate: Value of opportunities closed won in the last rolling 12 months versus the total value of opportunities (leading, lost, won or open) of the rolling 12 months shall be more than 30%. Minimum of 30 customer visits per month, with a 75%-25% split for non-partners (end user/consultant etc.) vs. partners. Forecast accuracy of 60% (2 1/2 month rolling). Regularly update sales activities related to Commit & Best Case Opportunities. Consistent attendance at internal meetings (Tiers, weekly meetings with other functions). Equal Opportunity Employer Honeywell International Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in the application and interview process, crucial job functions, and other employment benefits. Please contact us to request accommodation.

0d9d65d8388b77d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فطيرة الفلافل للمطاعم عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند الضرورة. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وترحيب، وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع المبالغ المالية. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة النقدية والإيصالات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. المرونة في التعامل مع تحديثات الأسعار وتطبيق الخصومات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل موظف الصندوق ضمن فريق المطعم، ويكون مسؤولاً عن نقطة البيع الرئيسية، مما يتطلب تفاعلاً مباشراً مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون المهارات والخبرة المطلوبة على التقديم.

0dd112fcc84d34e0.description: About the Role The Career Nest is seeking a Head Pastry Chef for a premium upscale café concept in Al Khobar, Jeddah, or Makkah. This full-time role is central to developing the identity of the venue through pastry and bakery operations, focusing on craftsmanship, precision, and innovation. The position requires a leader who combines technical mastery with operational discipline and a refined creative vision. Key Responsibilities Oversee all pastry and bakery production, ensuring consistency, quality, and adherence to international luxury standards. Lead the pastry team and manage daily operations. Contribute strategically to menu development, product innovation, and cost control initiatives. Manage production planning in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Oversee inventory, supplier coordination, and purchasing to maintain ingredient quality and operational efficiency. Stay informed of international pastry trends and apply them thoughtfully to enhance the concept. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5-8 years of professional pastry experience. At least 2-3 years in a leadership role within a premium patisserie, fine dining restaurant, or upscale café concept. Proven expertise in high-end pastry, viennoiserie, and baked goods. Strong attention to flavor balance, texture, and presentation. Quality and Compliance Maintain meticulous attention to detail across flavor, texture, and visual presentation. Ensure the pastry section consistently meets brand and operational expectations.

Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, and identify automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Create and maintain ESR service interfaces and Integration Builder objects, including ICOs where applicable. 0db5371424468e93.description: About the Role JTI is seeking a Commercial Planning Specialist STA to join the team in Jeddah. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on building a robust commercial data foundation and transforming data into actionable business insights. The role is central to enhancing data quality, ensuring reporting consistency, and supporting evidence-based decision-making across various commercial activities. Role Purpose and Contribution The Commercial Planning Specialist will support the market by improving data quality and consistency in reporting for sales, distribution, trade activation, and route-to-market activities. This role involves strengthening market data foundations, refining recurring reports, and providing practical analysis for business decisions. The specialist will collaborate with commercial teams, data owners, and functions including Sales, Trade Marketing, Marketing, and Finance. Key Responsibilities Map available market data sources and support the creation of a structured, documented, and scalable commercial database. Collect and consolidate data from internal systems, distributors, field teams, and approved external sources. Clean, reconcile, and validate datasets, identify gaps, duplicates, and inconsistencies, and coordinate corrective actions with data owners. Maintain data dictionaries, source definitions, naming conventions, refresh calendars, and basic quality controls. Build, automate, and maintain user-friendly reports and dashboards for sales, distribution, outlet coverage, route-to-market (RTM), and field execution key performance indicators (KPIs). Apply descriptive statistics, segmentation, and trend analysis to identify performance patterns, market gaps, risks, and opportunities. Support simulations and business cases related to outlet coverage, resource allocation, promotions, incentives, and commercial initiatives. Support the evaluation of trade and consumer activities, including return on investment (ROI) where data is available, and provide practical insights to Sales, Trade Marketing, Marketing, and Finance stakeholders. Partner with business teams and data owners to improve data availability, processes, and analytical capabilities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to work with commercial data and translate it into business insights. Experience in data collection, consolidation, cleaning, and validation. Proficiency in building and maintaining reports and dashboards. Strong analytical skills, including descriptive statistics, segmentation, and trend analysis. Application Process After applying, selected candidates can expect the following steps within 1-3 weeks of the job posting closure: Phone screening with a Talent Advisor, assessment tests, interviews, and finally, an offer. Each step is eliminatory and may vary by role type. JTI is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Applicants requiring specific support, alternative formats, or other access requirements are encouraged to communicate their needs.

0dccbc99d2ab6ee1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي علاقات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى مراجعة وتطوير سياسات العلاقات العامة، وإعداد خطط التواصل وتنفيذها، وتحسين الصورة الذهنية للشركة لدى الجمهور المستهدف. كما يشمل الدور استقبال الوفود والزوار وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومراجعة سياسة العلاقات العامة للجهة، وتقييم أثرها، واقتراح سبل تطويرها وتحسينها. تأسيس وبناء قنوات اتصال فعالة مع العملاء والشركاء الداخليين والخارجيين لتعزيز صورة الجهة وسمعتها وزيادة فاعلية عملياتها. متابعة التحضيرات والتجهيزات اللازمة لاستقبال الوفود الرسمية وكبار الزوار، وتأمين احتياجاتهم خلال فترة الزيارة. التنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية فيما يتعلق بمواعيد النقل وتنظيم الجولات الميدانية لتعريف الزوار بالجهة. بناء علاقات عمل مهنية وبناءة مع الجهات الخارجية والمؤسسات والشركات التابعة لها، وتقييم آثار هذه العلاقات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالعلاقات العامة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاقات العامة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط التواصل الاستراتيجية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية والحفاظ عليها. إتقان إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة ديناميكية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع مختلف الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية لضمان تحقيق أهداف العلاقات العامة للشركة. تقديم الطلبات لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذا الدور أو لتقديم طلب، يرجى التواصل مع شركة معين للموارد البشرية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

0dd25ab902418de5.job_title: Assistant Front Desk Manager Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island
0dd25ab902418de5.description: About Four Seasons and The Red Sea Destination Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is recognized for its commitment to luxury and guest experience, driven by a culture that values its team members. The company focuses on creating lasting impressions through genuine connections. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island within The Red Sea destination, situated along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. This destination emphasizes sustainable practices, renewable energy, and extensive conservation zones, offering a range of leisure and lifestyle facilities. The Four Seasons Resort at Red Sea Shura Island The Four Seasons Resort on Shura Island will feature approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with views of white sand beaches and clear waters. The property will include six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery center, and a Kids for All Seasons area. Guests will have access to a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two distinct beaches for families and adults, catering to both relaxation and water activities. Role Overview: Assistant Front Desk Manager Four Seasons Red Sea Shura Island is seeking an Assistant Front Desk Manager to join its team. This full-time role involves supporting the Front Office Manager in daily operations and ensuring exceptional guest experiences. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on delivering genuine care and warm hospitality. Key Responsibilities Supervise the Front Desk team to ensure efficient guest check-in and check-out procedures. Support the Front Office Manager in managing daily operations, scheduling, team development, and service standards. Resolve guest concerns and requests promptly with genuine care and effective service recovery. Ensure all guest preferences and special requests are accurately recorded and communicated across departments. Oversee training and mentoring of Guest Services Agents and support team members in daily duties. Assist in the development of front desk procedures and systems in preparation for the resort opening. Collaborate with Housekeeping, Concierge, Guest Experience, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest journey. Handle VIP arrivals and special occasions with personalized attention and elevated service. Monitor guest satisfaction scores and contribute to strategies for continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a similar role within the hospitality industry. Demonstrated ability to supervise and mentor a team. Experience in managing daily front office operations. Strong problem-solving skills and a guest-focused approach. Work Environment and Culture The Assistant Front Desk Manager will work in a full-time capacity at the Four Seasons Resort on Shura Island, located between Umluj and Al Wajh. The role is part of a team dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining talented professionals to deliver the Four Seasons service standard.

0d04f322b298859b.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a PTW Coordinator to manage and oversee the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system at project sites. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring that all high-risk activities are properly authorized, controlled, and executed in strict compliance with project HSE procedures and client requirements. The ideal candidate will have 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and administer the site Permit-to-Work system for all applicable activities. Review PTW applications for completeness and ensure all required approvals are obtained before work commences. Coordinate permits for various high-risk activities, including electrical work, hot work, excavation, confined space entry, work at height, lifting operations, and isolation/LOTO procedures. Verify that all necessary supporting documents, such as risk assessments, method statements, and JSA/JHA, are attached to permits. Ensure appropriate isolations, barricading, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and other control measures are in place prior to permit issuance. Liaise effectively with Permit Issuers, Permit Receivers, EHS, Construction, and Operations teams. Maintain an accurate and up-to-date PTW register, tracking permit status, validity, suspension, and closure. Conduct regular site checks to verify ongoing compliance with approved permits and their specified conditions. Ensure permits are properly suspended, extended, or closed as required. Prevent unauthorized work and promptly escalate any PTW violations or unsafe conditions. Conduct PTW awareness and refresher briefings for relevant site personnel. Maintain comprehensive PTW records for audits and management reporting. Support PTW audits and recommend improvements to enhance the permit system's effectiveness. Ensure full compliance with company, client, and Saudi regulatory HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in administering or coordinating Permit-to-Work systems. Demonstrated understanding of HSE procedures and client requirements related to high-risk activities. Ability to review and verify technical documents such as risk assessments and method statements. Required Skills Strong organizational and coordination skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective team collaboration. Attention to detail and a commitment to safety protocols. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and registers. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

0d23ee58a95722e7.description: About Clinique La Prairie and the Role Clinique La Prairie, established in 1931 in Montreux, Switzerland, is an internationally recognized destination for health and longevity programs, delivered with luxury Swiss hospitality. This full-time position for a Food and Beverage Manager is based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role involves designing, building, and leading the Food and Beverage program across all outlets at Clinique La Prairie AMAALA. Role Purpose and Context The Food and Beverage Manager serves as the senior manager on duty for the F&B service team. Given that no alcohol is served on-site, this role carries significant expertise and authority in non-alcoholic beverage programs. The manager ensures that all food and beverage offerings, from tea and water to functional and fermented drinks, align with the guest's longevity journey, are executed to an ultra-luxury standard, and are commercially controlled. This position acts as a key brand ambassador, embodying values of excellence, discretion, innovation, and premium service, and works closely with the Executive Head Chef, Nutrition team, and CLP Headquarters to ensure alignment with corporate standards and the CLP Longevity Handbook. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and manage the food and beverage program for the All Day Dining bar, Juice Bar, and Tea Lounge, based on the CLP Longevity Bar Handbook and adapted to the AMAALA context. Create signature non-alcoholic beverages and pairings, including functional shots, infused waters, fermented drinks, mocktails, and smoothies. Develop a distinctive tea program combining international wellness teas with Saudi and Arabian herbal heritage. Curate water and coffee programs, including premium water selection and barista standards. Extend the food and beverage program to all F&B touchpoints without dedicated beverage staff, such as Room Service, Beach Club, and in-room amenities. Build the storytelling for each food and beverage item, integrating local and regional ingredients where appropriate and validated. Ensure all food and beverage offerings are compatible with CLP programs and translate into clear, appealing options for guests, validated by the Nutrition team. Identify, source, and qualify specialist suppliers in coordination with Procurement, managing regional and international supply plans. Line manage F&B Supervisors, setting objectives, conducting performance reviews, and supporting their development. Act as manager on duty when no Supervisor is present and cover one Supervisor shift per week, deputizing for the Director of Food & Beverage in their absence. Build and deliver the beverage training curriculum for the service team. Write and maintain food and beverage SOPs and standard recipe cards, ensuring compliance with brand standards and LQA requirements. Oversee consistent execution across all outlets through floor presence, tastings, and quality audits, ensuring compliance with HACCP and food safety systems. Deliver the food and beverage program in line with the pre-opening critical path, including concept, recipes, suppliers, OS&E, SOPs, and training. Design food and beverage rituals across the guest journey and engage personally with guests to anticipate preferences. Prepare and manage the food and beverage budget, monitor costs, and ensure accurate stock control and monthly inventories. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in Food and Beverage management. Demonstrated expertise in designing and leading comprehensive F&B programs, particularly in a luxury hospitality setting. Experience with non-alcoholic beverage programs, including functional and fermented drinks. Proven ability to manage supplier relationships and complex supply chain logistics. Strong leadership skills with experience in team management and training. Understanding of operational excellence, including SOP development, quality audits, and food safety standards (HACCP). Experience in pre-opening phases of hospitality establishments is beneficial. Financial acumen for budget management, cost control, and inventory. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, within an ultra-luxury hospitality environment focused on health and longevity programs. The role requires close collaboration with culinary and nutrition teams, as well as corporate headquarters.

0d759c1a4b770743.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التعمير والانشاء عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، مدينة الخبر. هذا الدور مخصص للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة، حيث يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. سيعمل المهندس بدوام كامل، وستتركز مهامه على إعداد ومراجعة التصاميم الهندسية المدنية للمشاريع، مع ضمان توافقها مع المتطلبات الفنية والمعايير المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس المدني مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمل الهندسي بكفاءة ودقة، وتشمل هذه المسؤوليات ما يلي: إعداد وتطوير التصاميم والرسومات الهندسية المدنية للمشاريع. مراجعة المخططات والتأكد من مطابقتها للكودات والمواصفات المعتمدة. إعداد حسابات التصميم الإنشائي والمدني وتحليل البيانات الفنية. التنسيق مع التخصصات الأخرى مثل المعمارية والكهربائية والميكانيكية لضمان تكامل التصاميم. إعداد ومراجعة الرسومات التنفيذية (Shop Drawings) والتفاصيل الفنية. مراجعة طلبات المعلومات (RFIs) وتقديم الحلول الفنية المناسبة. إعداد وحصر الكميات (BOQ) والمواصفات الفنية عند الحاجة. تقديم الدعم الفني للمشاريع والمواقع فيما يخص أعمال التصميم. مراجعة واعتماد المخططات المقدمة من الاستشاريين والمقاولين الفرعيين. المشاركة في اجتماعات التنسيق الفني مع العملاء والاستشاريين. رفع التقارير الفنية الدورية لمدير المكتب الفني. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن تتوافر في المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية أو التصميم الإنشائي. معرفة جيدة بالكودات والمواصفات الفنية ذات الصلة. القدرة على استخدام برامج التصميم الهندسي ذات الصلة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات الفنية والشخصية لضمان الأداء الفعال: مهارات قوية في إعداد وتطوير التصاميم والرسومات الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الفنية وإعداد الحسابات الإنشائية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع مختلف التخصصات والعملاء. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في مراجعة المخططات والوثائق. القدرة على حل المشكلات الفنية وتقديم الدعم اللازم. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل في شركة التعمير والانشاء بالمنطقة الشرقية، مدينة الخبر. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع الأقسام الداخلية والجهات الخارجية لضمان تحقيق أهداف المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

0dc84a717f8e7a0b.description: About the Role alfanar Group is seeking a ***** COUNSEL, CONTRACTS to provide comprehensive legal support for its EPC and project development businesses. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and focuses on renewable energy, power, water, and infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia and international markets. The role covers the entire project lifecycle, from tendering and bidding to project development. Draft, review, and negotiate EPC, EP, construction, turnkey, supply, and O&M contracts for power, water, renewable energy, transmission, distribution, and industrial projects, utilizing FIDIC and bespoke forms. Negotiate subcontracts, supply, consortium, JV, and teaming agreements, ensuring alignment with main contracts. Support contract administration, including notices, variations, EOT, delays, payments, commissioning, close-out, and remedies. Review bonds and parent company guarantees, including calls and defenses. Advise on contractual risk mitigation strategies and commercial negotiations. Project Development and Investment Support Support development and investment in renewable energy, power, water, and infrastructure projects from origination to financial close. Draft and negotiate joint development, JV, shareholders', consortium, cooperation, and MoU agreements. Advise on PPAs, water purchase, implementation, concession, land, lease, grid connection, and government support agreements. 0d17fea3c254be0a.description: About the Internship AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is offering a Data Center Technician Internship in Riyadh. 0d37f2651e5c41fd.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Commercial Financial Controller to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 0dd68a0d279ae5b9.description: About Mahally: Mahally is Saudi Arabia’s home for local commerce. We bring thousands of Saudi stores — across beauty, fashion, home, food, gifting, electronics, and more — into one marketplace and one app, making it easier for customers to discover and buy from local brands. We’re more than a catalogue. Mahally is a demand engine for Saudi merchants — helping great products get discovered and connecting shoppers with local businesses they may not have found otherwise. About the Role: We’re looking for an SEO Manager to own Mahally’s organic search strategy end-to-end, covering technical SEO, content and organic growth, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO). This is not a keyword-reporting role. Mahally is a large, dynamic marketplace with millions of URLs, constantly changing stores and products, and significant opportunities to improve how search engines crawl, index, understand, and rank our content. You’ll lead the work to strengthen our technical SEO foundation, improve indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and create sustainable organic growth that isn’t dependent on individual merchants or products. You’ll also help shape how Mahally appears across emerging AI and answer engines, including ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI-powered search experiences. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Content, and Merchant teams , you’ll turn SEO opportunities into clear priorities and measurable business impact. Success will be measured not only by rankings and visibility, but by qualified organic traffic, orders, and GMV. What You'll Do 1- Fix the technical foundation Own technical SEO for a marketplace at scale: crawl budget, indexation, canonicalisation, pagination, faceted navigation, internal linking, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and JS rendering. Diagnose and resolve index bloat — decide which page types deserve to be indexed at all, and enforce it through robots directives, canonical strategy, and sitemap hygiene. Solve for churn: define what happens to a store or product URL when it disappears, so we stop leaking equity every time a merchant leaves. Partner with Engineering on an SEO backlog that actually ships — with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and measured impact after release. 2- Build organic surfaces that last Design and grow durable page types — category, collection, brand, city, intent, and comparison pages — that don't depend on any single merchant staying. Own the content roadmap for organic: Arabic-first keyword and intent research, briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh cycles. Optimise store and product templates: titles, meta, headings, structured data, on-page copy, and merchandising signals. Build internal linking as a system, not a one-off project. 3- Own AI and answer-engine visibility (GEO/AEO) Define and execute Mahally's strategy for generative and answer engines: crawler access policy, structured data, entity clarity, citable content, and brand presence in AI answers. Make deliberate decisions about which AI crawlers we allow and why — and be able to defend the trade-off between control and visibility. Track and report where Mahally appears in AI answers for commercial Saudi queries, and close the gaps. 4- Measure honestly Own Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and log-file analysis. Build reporting that ties organic to sessions, orders, and GMV — not just impressions. Set up rank, indexation, and coverage monitoring with alerts, so we catch a drop in days rather than a quarter. Run structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns and report the causal read where you can get one. 5- Work across the business Brief and influence Engineering, Product, and Content without owning their roadmaps. Guide merchants on the content and imagery that make their pages rank and convert. Present organic performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership with a clear point of view and a clear ask. What Success Looks Like You’ll help Mahally build an organic acquisition engine that scales with the marketplace — improving how efficiently our pages are crawled and indexed, increasing qualified organic discovery, creating durable search surfaces, and strengthening Mahally’s presence across both traditional and AI-powered search. Ultimately, your work will translate organic visibility into more customers, more orders, and more growth for Saudi merchants. 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience , with proven experience managing SEO for a large-scale e-commerce platform, marketplace, classifieds site, or other high-volume website . Strong technical SEO expertise , with hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalisation, and site architecture . 0dfda9d8aa9848c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الظهران. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع أنشطة الصيانة، وتوزيع المهام، وتطوير قدرات فريق العمل لضمان كفاءة العمليات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل الخاصة بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لعمليات الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتصميم برامج تدريبية متخصصة لتنمية مهاراتهم. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو الإشراف عليها. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على إدارة فريق العمل وتطوير خطط الصيانة بفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على قيادة وتوجيه فريق العمل. مهارات تحليلية لتقييم الاحتياجات وتحديد الأولويات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والإدارية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل في مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات بالظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. ستتاح للمشرف فرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع الأقسام المختلفة. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

0d999e7a2baba4c0.description: We are seeking an experienced Plant Labelling Officer to support the accurate identification, documentation, labelling, mapping, and interpretation of living plant collections within a Botanic Garden environment. The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate plant labels, collection records, databases, mapping systems, and visitor-facing botanical information. The successful candidate will work closely with botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other technical specialists to ensure plant identities and collection information remain accurate, consistent, and up to date. Key Responsibilities Create, install, inspect, update, and maintain plant labels across indoor and outdoor collections. Ensure labels include accurate scientific names, common names, family information, geographic origin, accession details, and other relevant information. Verify botanical nomenclature and taxonomy using recognised botanical references. Conduct regular audits to identify missing, damaged, outdated, duplicated, or inaccurate labels. Coordinate the correction and replacement of plant labels. Work with botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other specialists to verify plant identification. Maintain consistency between physical labels, accession records, databases, maps, and collection-management systems. Manage and update plant-record databases and maintain accurate records of plant accessions, locations, provenance, movements, replacements, and losses. Support plant accessioning and deaccessioning activities. Maintain plant collection mapping systems and conduct field verification of plant locations. Support the integration of plant records with GIS, digital mapping, and collection-management systems . Develop and maintain botanical interpretation and visitor-facing information materials. Translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear and accessible content. Support digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, interactive maps, and digital collection platforms. Conduct quality-control reviews of physical and digital plant information. Support plant inventories and collection audits. Maintain appropriate data-quality, backup, and version-control practices. Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, Plant Taxonomy , or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is advantageous. Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in horticulture, botanical collections, plant identification, education, or technical capacity-building. Strong knowledge of plant identification, taxonomy, nomenclature, and classification , with the ability to identify plants using morphological characteristics, botanical references, and taxonomic keys. Proven experience in plant labelling, living-collection documentation, accessioning, provenance, and collection management . Experience managing plant databases, electronic records, GIS, mapping systems, and digital collection-management platforms . Strong research, information-verification, data-quality, and quality-control skills, with excellent attention to detail. Experience developing and delivering horticulture training programmes , including practical, hands-on training. Experience developing training materials, technical guides, manuals, presentations, and educational resources related to horticulture. Experience assessing training needs, evaluating competency, and supporting internships, apprenticeships, vocational training, or work-based learning programmes. Experience conducting horticulture workshops, demonstrations, or community-engagement programmes. Ability to translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear, engaging, visitor-facing content. Experience working collaboratively with botanists, horticulturists, curators, researchers, educational institutions, and other technical specialists . Familiarity with digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, and interactive mapping is advantageous. Previous experience in a botanic garden, public garden, horticulture institution, nursery, educational institution, or comparable environment is preferred. Strong written communication, technical documentation, organisational, and problem-solving skills. Professional training or educational delivery experience in English and Arabic is preferred.
